groups.offBehavior: Preserve existing inventory and references; discovery is a launch prerequisite.
Preserve saved plans and read access; block new plan generation. Core launch profile keeps manual planning enabled.
Preserve campaign history, existing commitments, expiry and reconciliation; disable new campaign mutations only where explicitly specified.
Disable new exports/shares; retain authorized access to previously issued documents.
Stop optional AI work and hide recommendations; retain manual planning and clearly labelled historical outputs.
Stop collection and hide current enrichment; preserve lawful historical evidence with source and age. Never replace unavailable counts with zero.
Disable new optional AdTech booking entry points; preserve classic holds, existing booking reads, expiry, cancellation and obligation reconciliation.
Stop new payment intents; retain authenticated callbacks, reconciliation, refunds and history for existing obligations.
Preserve existing proofs and commitment history; disable optional new collection/reporting only as documented per action.
Stop new enrollment and planned optional analytics; revoke/disable collection deliberately, retain required existing-device operational cleanup and lawful history.
Stop new sends and cancel unsent optional work; settle existing delivery receipts without duplicate sends.
